newsitem.title: USA: KANSAS FED CATTLE TRADE VERY SLOW AT $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: KANSAS FED CATTLE TRADE VERY SLOW AT $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not enough slaughter steers or heifers confirmed for an adequate market test, USDA said. Inquiry was moderate and demand light.

Sales confirmed on 200 slaughter steers and 800 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 64,500 head confirmed including 38,600 head or about 60 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Few Select with end Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 64.00; few Select and Choice 1350 lb Holsteins 57.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1175 lbs 64.00.
Confirmed - 1,000 last week - none last year - none
Wk to date 64,500 last week - 95,900 last year - 101,800
